signal: Celigo was named the only 2025 Gartner Peer Insights Customers' Choice for iPaaS and is rolling out AI-driven error resolution and autonomous agents across 4,000+ customers.

email.body1:
Shivani, saw Celigo was named the only Gartner Peer Insights Customers' Choice for iPaaS and is rolling out autonomous agents.

At 4,000+ customers, the RevOps bottleneck is usually signal-to-action latency: in-market accounts surface faster than the team can act on them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, turning signals into booked meetings with no rep time: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Celigo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Shivani, quick follow-up for Celigo.

At your scale, the measurable lift usually hides in the handoff between signal and outreach, where stale data and slow follow-up quietly cost replies that should have converted. Most teams never see exactly where the funnel leaks, so the same gaps repeat every quarter. Tighter sequencing alone tends to lift response rates 50-70%.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three specific things I'd change, and show where Celigo is leaking pipeline today.
email.body3:
Shivani, last bit of proof for Celigo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Celigo's reply rate likely compares to other scaled SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Shivani, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Operating at your scale keeps a RevOps team plenty busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I'll tailor it to Celigo either way.
